description: Morphological Leaf Disease Progression Manifest for Precision AgriTech Platform

stages.symptom_markers: Healthy turgid leaflet with intact lamina, normal chlorophyll pigmentation, and crisp venation.
stages.agronomic_advice: Maintain preventive cultural hygiene; ensure drip irrigation to avoid foliar wetness.

stages.symptom_markers: Discrete brown-black lesions with faint yellow chlorotic halos; emerging concentric target-like rings on lower foliage.
stages.agronomic_advice: Apply preventive copper hydroxide or chlorothalonil barrier before upcoming precipitation events.

stages.symptom_markers: Extensive coalescing necrotic blotches, brittle necrotic leaf tissue collapse, and widespread chlorosis leading to blight defoliation.
stages.agronomic_advice: Immediately prune and isolate infected stems; apply systemic fungicide (mancozeb/difenoconazole); lock out overhead irrigation.

stages.symptom_markers: Vibrant emerald green leaf blade with smooth ovate margins, healthy stomatal turgor, and zero necrotic marks.
stages.agronomic_advice: Inspect field margins; monitor ambient relative humidity and leaf wetness hours.

stages.symptom_markers: Irregular pale water-soaked grayish lesions emerging on leaf margins and expanding rapidly under humid conditions.
stages.agronomic_advice: Initiate protective spray program (metalaxyl/mancozeb) prior to prolonged wet periods.

stages.symptom_markers: Dark purplish-black necrotic collapse with white sporulation mycelial halos at lesion margins; irreversible tissue degradation.
stages.agronomic_advice: Emergency systemic intervention; halt overhead watering immediately; destroy heavily blighted vine refuse.

stages.symptom_markers: Uniform linear blade with prominent central midrib, intact cuticle, and healthy light-to-forest green parallel striations.
stages.agronomic_advice: Ensure balanced nitrogen nutrition; scout lower canopy during early vegetative stages.

stages.symptom_markers: Small oval to elongate cinnamon-brown pustules erupting through the epidermis along parallel veins, encircled by chlorotic halos.
stages.agronomic_advice: Monitor rust pustule coverage on ear leaf; evaluate triazole or strobilurin fungicide threshold.

stages.symptom_markers: Dense coalescent dark reddish-brown to black teliospores; longitudinal necrotic banding causing premature leaf death and tip shredding.
stages.agronomic_advice: Apply fungicide immediately if rust threatens upper canopy before dent stage (R5); note hybrid resistance for next planting.

stages.symptom_markers: Broad elliptical glossy apple foliage with fine marginal serrations, rich green cuticle, and intact vascular arching.
stages.agronomic_advice: Maintain seasonal primary scab ascospore monitoring; schedule preventive cover sprays based on Mills periods.

stages.symptom_markers: Dull olive-green to smoky velvety spots with indistinct margins developing on upper leaf surface, accompanied by slight leaf crinkling.
stages.agronomic_advice: Apply kick-back curative fungicides (flusilazole/difenoconazole) within 72 hours of primary infection event.

stages.symptom_markers: Thickened dark corky scab lesions, extensive chlorotic yellowing, puckered distortion, and premature necrotic leaf drop.
stages.agronomic_advice: Apply autumn urea spray or shredded leaf sanitation to accelerate leaf decay and reduce overwintering pseudothecia inocula.
